title: Nathan Twining reference in Disclosure Day, with the Twining memo and Majestic 12
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Nathan Twining reference in Disclosure Day, with the Twining memo and Majestic 12, about 1947 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: who's head of air material command 1947. He wrote the Twining memo. He was rumored Majestic 12 and 12 people are missing.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a reference in a film called Disclosure Day to Nathan Twining, the general who in 1947 headed Air Materiel Command, the military's aircraft equipment and research branch. Michels says Twining wrote the Twining memo, a 1947 letter about flying disc reports, and was rumoured to belong to Majestic 12, a supposed secret group of twelve officials said in disputed documents to manage the UFO matter, and he adds that in the film twelve people are missing. He reads it as the film nodding to that history, which would mean the filmmakers are hinting at real events.
